label: Alien registration: deadline from entry
unit: days from the date of entry
appliesTo: Foreign nationals intending to stay in Korea for more than 90 days
why: The first deadline of a stay in Korea, and the one that gates almost everything after it — a phone line for identity verification, a bank account, and a tenant's opposing power all wait on the registration number. Recorded because it is routinely described as a deadline to collect a card by, which is a different obligation from the one the statute imposes.

history.note: The obligation is to complete the alien registration, not merely to have applied or to hold a card by then. A separate registration point can apply where status is granted or changed inside Korea. Treating 90 days as a target rather than a ceiling is the practical mistake: appointment availability and document preparation both run ahead of it, and everything downstream is blocked until the registration number exists.
